{{Quote|If we can get the Ansionians to commit to pulling out of the Republic, no one will really care. But because of their alliances, their withdrawal should be enough to sway their already vacillating partners in both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Treaty to follow.|[[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]|<ref name="Approaching">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''Keitum''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ariarch sector/Legends|Ariarch sector]]. It was the origin point of the [[Keitumite]]s and was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a signatory of the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]], the latter of which bound it to the planet [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of the Independent Systems]] sought to facilitate the secession of the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty participants from the Republic; however, the Separatist plans were foiled by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]], which resulted in the planet and the alliance remaining loyal to the Republic.

==Description==
Keitum<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Fry">{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/294566730532024320|[[Jason Fry]]|archivefile=File:JasonFryAtlas.png}}</ref> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> situated in the [[Keitum system/Legends|Keitum system]], a part of the [[Ariarch sector/Legends|Ariarch sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay at the endpoint of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rago Run]],<ref name="Rago Run" /> which connected it to the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector's]] [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
{{Quote|Assuming the internal divisions continue to widen, I would expect a formal vote on whether to withdraw from the Republic within half a standard year.''"<br />"''At which point we can look on with satisfaction as those who have been traditionally allied to Ansion follow suit, and those allied to the allies fall in turn.|Ansion's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mousul]] and [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]|<ref name="Approaching" />}}
[[File:Ansion-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty linked Keitum to Ansion (pictured).]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Keitum was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] at some point between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">{{CSWECite|II|206|Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty}} establishes that Keitum was both a signatory of the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]] and a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]] linked the planet to<ref name="CSWE" /> the Mid Rim planet [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]<ref name="TEA" /> both commercially and militarily.<ref name="CSWE" /> By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="22 BBY" /> Keitum was also a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty placed Keitum in a web of mutual affiliations with the [[Dorin system/Legends|Dorin]] and [[Mondress system/Legends|Mondress systems]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]; the [[Eeropha system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]; and the Ansion, [[Glom Tho system/Legends|Glom Tho]], [[Lonnaw system/Legends|Lonnaw]], and [[Malari system/Legends|Malari systems]] in the Mid Rim. Keitum, its partner [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], and the [[Malarian Alliance]]&mdash;also affiliated with Ansion&mdash;all had treaties of their own with other worlds as well, which led to the superficially insignificant Ansion lying at the center of a network of approximately forty [[Politics/Legends|politically]] connected systems.<ref name="TEA" /> The signatory systems of both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty were individually considering leaving the Republic<ref name="Approaching" /> during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attempted to facilitate the secession of Ansion from the Republic, which was predicted by the Separatists to cause a cascade of secession by all the systems linked to the planet via its treaties, as well. However, a [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]] undertaken by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on behalf of the Republic resulted in both that world<ref name="TEA" /> and its partners remaining loyal to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government,<ref name="Approaching" /> foiling the Separatist plans.<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the Republic's [[Seventh Army|Seventh Sector Army]] was tasked with defending Keitum's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the Confederacy.<ref name="EGTW" /> At some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the newly appointed Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Churnis [[Sector/Legends|sector]] declared all existing treaties and alliances involving Ansion to be null and void,<ref name="TEA" /> and, by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Keitum lay within the borders of the Empire. Between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the planet was situated in [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&ndash;controlled space,<ref name="EGTW" /> but control over it had been assumed by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] by [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Keitum was the origin world of the social group known as the [[Keitumite]]s.<ref name="CSWE" /> The Keitum system's population around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between one hundred and five hundred million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keitum was first indirectly mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Keitum system, and therefore the planet, in grid square J-6.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the star systems listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent planets or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the origin world of the Keitumites to be named in accordance with the Keitum system.<ref name="Fry" />
